87:t_2:35.en:
$$ランド$$
「Knowing those two, I don't think there's any need to worry, though.」

87:t_2:37.en:
$$マオ$$
「Just looking at him makes the heat come crashing over you!」

87:t_2:38.en:
$$宗介$$
「The only saving grace is that the Captain isn't here.」

87:t_2:39.en:
$$ロラン$$
「$$ランド$$'s Heat Smile is in top form, I see.」

87:t_2:41.en:
$$メール$$
「All right then, let me introduce ourselves to everyone we're meeting for the first time.」

87:t_2:42.en:
$$メール$$
「I'm $$メール・ビーター$$. I handle sales and accounting for the wandering repair shop $$ビーター・サービス$$.」

87:t_2:43.en:
$$ランド$$
「I'm $$ランド・トラビス$$. Known to all as $$ザ・ヒート$$.」

87:t_2:44.en:
$$メール$$
「And he's also my darling, by the way.」

87:t_2:46.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Man... just how much of an outlaw are you...?」

87:t_2:47.en:
$$ランド$$
「Explaining that would take a long time, so I'll save it for later...」

87:t_2:48.en:
$$メール$$
「Just so you know, I'm 17, so I'm only a little over ten years younger than my darling.」

87:t_2:50.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Could you be... that rumored 《$$時が止まった$$》 girl?」

87:t_2:51.en:
$$メール$$
「That's in the past. These days I'm growing up nice and healthy, thank you.」

87:t_2:52.en:
$$クルツ$$
(So that means this baby face and flat chest are the real deal...)

87:t_2:53.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
(In a way, it's one of the mysteries of the human body...)

87:t_2:54.en:
$$ロラン$$
「I'm $$ロラン・セアック$$. I'm the pilot of the $$ホワイトドール$$.」

87:t_2:56.en:
$$ロラン$$
「That's the name of the mechanical doll I ride. Apparently its real name is $$ターンエー$$, though.」

87:t_2:57.en:
$$マオ$$
(So that's the $$ターンタイプ$$ mobile suit I've heard rumors about...)

87:t_2:58.en:
$$マオ$$
(I hear that unit's so-called 《$$月光蝶$$》 system once wiped out the civilization of the world that made up the $$ＵＣＷ$$. We'll have to be very careful handling it.)

87:t_2:61.en:
$$ティファ$$
「$$ロラン$$ was entrusted with the $$ホワイトドール$$ by $$ディアナ$$ of the Moon, as someone who will use its power properly.」

87:t_2:62.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「$$ディアナ・ソレル$$... So she's the ruler of the $$ムーンレィス$$.」

87:t_2:63.en:
$$ロラン$$
「I understand how terrifying the $$月光蝶$$ is, too. That's exactly why I want to use the $$ホワイトドール$$ for what's right.」

87:t_2:64.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Well... judging by today's fight, too, he blocked that scorpion bastard's poison for us. Leave it to this guy and there shouldn't be any problem.」

87:t_2:65.en:
$$マオ$$
「You're right. I'll be counting on you from now on, $$ロラン$$.」

87:t_2:67.en:
$$オズマ$$
「...I'm not happy with how this ended, but it splits $$サイデリアル$$'s chain of command on the Amelia Continent.」

87:t_2:68.en:
$$オズマ$$
「On top of that, now that their main force has moved to $$蒼の地球$$, let's leave the rest to the local Resistance.」

87:t_2:70.en:
$$オズマ$$
「As we set out to do, we've defeated the $$サイデリアル$$ on $$翠の地球$$, and our forces have been strengthened.」

87:t_2:71.en:
$$オズマ$$
「We'll return to $$蒼の地球$$, join up with the other units there, and challenge the $$新地球皇国$$ to a decisive battle.」

87:t_2:73.en:
$$アルト$$
「A nation $$サイデリアル$$ built on $$蒼の地球$$. Most of the Earth is under its rule.」

87:t_2:74.en:
$$宗介$$
「Just as on $$翠の地球$$, those guys have set up $$レイライン$$s on $$蒼の地球$$ too and are extracting $$次元力$$.」

87:t_2:75.en:
$$レド$$
「$$次元力$$... So that's the energy $$サイデリアル$$ is using.」

87:t_2:76.en:
$$オズマ$$
「$$ガロード$$, $$レド$$, $$ロラン$$... and $$ランド$$. Will you come with us?」

87:t_2:78.en:
$$メール$$
「Coming out of nowhere from space and doing whatever they pleased... I can't forgive $$サイデリアル$$!」

87:t_2:79.en:
$$ガロード$$
「If we don't kick them off $$蒼の地球$$, the fight on $$翠の地球$$ won't ever end either, right.」

87:t_2:80.en:
$$ロラン$$
「I feel the same way. Please let me help.」

87:t_2:83.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Let's go, $$レド$$. You decided you'd see the wide world, remember?」

87:t_2:84.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Heh heh... so we're finally heading out to space. I'll brag to everyone when we get back to the fleet.」

87:t_2:86.en:
$$レド$$
「Major $$オズマ$$, I will go with you as well.」

87:t_2:88.en:
$$レド$$
「Yes. I am a member of this unit now, too.」

87:t_2:89.en:
$$レド$$
「Regardless of the $$人類銀河同盟$$, I will fulfill that duty.」

87:t_2:90.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Understood. You have my thanks for your cooperation.」

87:t_2:91.en:
$$ランド$$
「...By the way, what about the pilot of the blue robot I saved?」

87:t_2:92.en:
$$宗介$$
「$n is in the medical room, where the effects of that scorpion's poison are being checked.」

87:t_2:96.en:
$$ランド$$
(Those words $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ said as we parted... The $$いがみ合う双子$$ will save us...)

87:t_10:4.en:
$$ランド$$
「So you're the famous AG. Still, they really made you well...」

87:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah... no, no. You mustn't give in to your inner urges and try to peel off my exterior.」

87:t_10:6.en:
$$ランド$$
「Are you trying to provoke me, by any chance?」

87:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Not at all. I know full well that angering $$ザ・ヒート$$ never ends well.」

87:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now is the time to endure, $$ランド$$. $$ガンレオン$$ is waiting for its moment, after all.」

87:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I am also the one responsible for maintaining the $$ジェニオン$$, you know. I've come to understand a little about the $$スフィア$$s, too.」

87:t_10:11.en:
$$ランド$$
「...Pathetic, isn't it. I've been tinkering with machines all this time as a repairman, and I can't figure out the one that matters most, my own.」

87:t_10:12.en:
$$ランド$$
「Sure, $$ガンレオン$$ has more power than before now that it can go into Magna Mode...」

87:t_10:13.en:
$$ランド$$
「But that last something just won't move... Is the problem me, or is it the machine...」

87:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Hmm... if you don't mind, would you let me take a look at $$ガンレオン$$?」

87:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I-it's all right! I won't attach 2000 mm cannons, Terabeam Rifles, or Zankokuto blades or anything!」

87:t_10:17.en:
$$ランド$$
「...All right, AG. At this point I want every clue I can get. Help me out.」

87:t_10:19.en:
$$ランド$$
「Well, I've got a little errand to take care of. See you later.」
